surprises.head: Pittsburgh controlled the chances
surprises.body: Expected goals ran 4.7 to 1.5 for Pittsburgh, with empty nets left out.

surprises.head: Pittsburgh shot far more than usual
surprises.body: 75.4 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5, adjusted for score and venue, against its usual 60.0.

surprises.head: Pittsburgh tried a different line
surprises.body: B. Lizotte, C. Dewar, E. Soderblom played 7:10 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of Pittsburgh’s usual lines.

surprises.head: Philadelphia tried a different line
surprises.body: C. Dvorak, T. Foerster, T. Konecny played 6:20 together at 5-on-5, a trio that isn’t one of Philadelphia’s usual lines.
